# components/keycap

## Type Aliases

### KeycapTone

```ts
type KeycapTone = "neutral" | "primary" | "accent" | "inverse" | "destructive";
```

Molded key colors. `inverse` is the contrasting key; `destructive` stays neutral
until hovered or focused; the rest follow the theme.

---

### KeycapSize

```ts
type KeycapSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";
```

Keycap sizes: a legend chip, a dock key and a big face key.

### KeycapButtonProps

```ts
type KeycapButtonProps = Omit<
  ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
  "children"
> &
  object;
```

Props accepted by KeycapButton.

#### Type Declaration

| Name        | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`     | `ReactNode`                 | Visible name of the action, e.g. "Build". `null` makes an icon-only key, which then needs an `aria-label`.                                          |
| `shortcut?` | `string`                    | The keyboard key that runs the same action, shown as a small keycap.                                                                                |
| `icon?`     | `ReactNode`                 | Decorative icon before the label.                                                                                                                   |
| `readout?`  | `ReactNode`                 | Extra readout after the label, such as a PixelNumber count.                                                                                         |
| `tone?`     | [`KeycapTone`](#keycaptone) | -                                                                                                                                                   |
| `pressed?`  | `boolean`                   | Toggle state for mode keys. `undefined` is a momentary key; a boolean adds `aria-pressed` and lights the key's indicator.                           |
| `expanded?` | `boolean`                   | Disclosure state for keys that open a palette or window. A boolean adds `aria-expanded` and lights the lamp; use it instead of `pressed` for menus. |

## Variables

### Keycap

```ts
const Keycap: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> & object & RefAttributes<HTMLElement>
>;
```

One molded key legend, rendered as native `<kbd>`: the key a player presses. The
key sits on its own travel so pressed and resting keys take the same room.

---

### KeycapButton

```ts
const KeycapButton: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "children"> &
    object &
    RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
>;
```

A chunky action key for game docks and toy panels. The host owns the action and
the keyboard binding; `shortcut` only labels it.
